headline: 새끼 오리 줄서기
이유가 진짜 있음

lines.say: 새끼 오리가 줄 서서 헤엄치는 이유, 진짜 있음.
lines.img: a mother duck swimming on a calm sunny pond followed by a neat line of fluffy yellow ducklings, bright daylight, gentle ripples
a cute fluffy duckling standing proudly on a sunny grassy bank, a plain shiny golden trophy cup beside it, bright blue sky

lines.say: 엄마가 만든 물결을 타고 감. 서핑임.
lines.sub: 엄마가 만든 물결을 타고 감 · 서핑임
lines.img: a fluffy yellow duckling riding a small smooth wave right behind a mother duck on a sunny pond, bright cheerful light
a duckling gliding effortlessly behind a mother duck on a bright pond, soft wave rolling beneath it, sunny morning
a long tidy line of fluffy yellow ducklings gliding calmly one after another on a sunny pond, smooth gentle ripples
a cute duckling at the back of a line of ducklings relaxing and floating happily on a sunny pond, toy-like bright style
